title: Mahler measures at interior CM points: proofs of two conjectures of Samart
summary: We prove two conjectures of Samart as identities of genuine Mahler measures. The first is the case $k=1$ of his evaluations for the family $(x+x^{-1})(y+y^{-1})(z+z^{-1})+k^{1/2}$: $m((x+x^{-1})(y+y^{-1})(z+z^{-1})+1)=4L'(g_7,0)$, where $g_7(τ)=η(τ)^3η(7τ)^3$ is the unique newform of $S_3(Γ_0(7),χ_{-7})$ (LMFDB label 7.3.b.a). The second is the conjugate pair of quadratic CM entries of his 2015 table: $n_2((47\pm 45\sqrt{-7})/2)=(4/7)(54L'(g_7,0)+L'(χ_{-7},-1))$, where $n_2(s):=2m((x+x^{-1})(y+y^{-1})(z+z^{-1})+\sqrt{s})$.
